script: The US military once drafted a plan to attack its own citizens, and blame Cuba for it. In 1962, the Joint Chiefs of Staff wrote a document proposing fake terror attacks on American soil, bombings and hijackings staged by the military itself. It even proposed sinking boats full of Cuban refugees just to provoke public outrage. The whole point was to fake a reason to invade Cuba, using tragedies the government would manufacture. President Kennedy was briefed on the plan, and rejected it outright in a meeting weeks later. The document vanished into classification for thirty five years, until a government records board finally released it in 1997. Nobody outside a small circle knew any of this had been proposed until decades after that meeting. The US military once drafted a plan to attack its own citizens, and almost nobody found out.

title: The US Military Once Drafted a Plan to Attack Its Own Citizens
description:
In 1962, the Joint Chiefs of Staff proposed staging fake attacks on American soil and blaming Cuba, to justify an invasion. Kennedy rejected it, and it stayed classified for 35 years.

Did you know a plan like this actually existed? Let me know in the comments.
